_comment: 3 reference dungeons. 'monsters' is the fixed fight sequence ending in a boss. Equipment/food are locked during a run unless the shop upgrade is owned.

chicken_coop.name: The Plucked Roost
chicken_coop.flavour: Something has been taking the settlement's fowl for weeks. It is bigger than a fox.

undead_graveyard.name: Barrow of Names
undead_graveyard.flavour: The barrows of Hearthfall have opened. The dead want their names back.

spider_forest.name: Broodweb Warren
spider_forest.flavour: Reedwrack Fen's heart, and the nest that keeps restocking it.

air_god_dungeon.name: Observatory of Gales
air_god_dungeon.flavour: The summit observatory's instruments still turn. Their keeper never left.

water_god_dungeon.name: Tidal Reliquary
water_god_dungeon.flavour: A drowned shrine that surfaces once a season, and never with the same rooms.

earth_god_dungeon.name: Deepstone Sanctum
earth_god_dungeon.flavour: The mine that broke the ridge. It goes further down than any survey admits.

fire_god_dungeon.name: Emberthrone Kiln
fire_god_dungeon.flavour: The furnace at the root of the ashfall. It is still burning, and it is fed.

into_the_mist.name: Into the Murk
into_the_mist.flavour: Follow the ash upstream. The Murk does not let you arrive where you aimed.

impending_darkness.name: The Long Dusk
impending_darkness.flavour: Nightfall that never lifts. Cut a path through it or be part of it.

underwater_city.name: Nhalassar, the Drowned City
underwater_city.flavour: A city that chose the water over the fire. It is still lit below.

throne_of_the_herald.name: Seat of the Herald
throne_of_the_herald.flavour: Where the ashfall was decided. Everything you have built is the price of stopping it.

cinderkin_forge.name: Cinderkin Forge
cinderkin_forge.flavour: Beneath the warrens, stolen iron is hammered into weapons for the next raid.

drowned_causeway.name: Drowned Causeway
drowned_causeway.flavour: The sunken road descends beneath the tide and ends at a barrow that should be inland.

rook_viaduct.name: Rook's Viaduct
rook_viaduct.flavour: The Rooks have fortified the broken viaduct and hired a Sunderhold veteran to hold it.

frostfang_den.name: Frostfang Den
frostfang_den.flavour: A wind-scoured cave shelters the pack that patrols Frostbound Reach.

greyharrow_deep.name: Greyharrow Deep
greyharrow_deep.flavour: The deep cut goes past the last supported floor. The foreman's lamp is still lit down there.

sunderhold_undercroft.name: Sunderhold Undercroft
sunderhold_undercroft.flavour: Beneath the Keep the garrison walled off a floor it could not clear, and left the centurion's banner on the wrong side of the door.

ashen_bastion_keep.name: The Ashen Keep
ashen_bastion_keep.flavour: The garrison sealed itself in. The seal held; the garrison did not.

gloamreach_sink.name: The Gloam Sink
gloamreach_sink.flavour: Where the marsh keeps what it has swallowed. It is not finished.

the_silent_gate.name: The Silent Gate
the_silent_gate.flavour: A gate the Herald never walked through, because he was already on the other side.

the_hollow_throne.name: The Hollow Throne
the_hollow_throne.flavour: The seat that was never the Herald's. It was only kept warm.

ascendant_trials.name: The Ascendant Trials
ascendant_trials.flavour: Every boss you beat, back and better. Repeat as desired.

astral_sanctum.name: Astral Sanctum
astral_sanctum.flavour: Legendary expedition. Entry provisions are consumed once per attempt, including a retreat or defeat. Repeated clears provide crafting materials.

storm_citadel.name: Storm Citadel
storm_citadel.flavour: Legendary expedition. Entry provisions are consumed once per attempt, including a retreat or defeat. Repeated clears provide crafting materials.

crown_of_embers.name: Crown of Embers
crown_of_embers.flavour: Legendary expedition. Entry provisions are consumed once per attempt, including a retreat or defeat. Repeated clears provide crafting materials.

threat_sundered_reaches.name: The Sundered Tyrant · Lair
threat_sundered_reaches.flavour: Regional threat. Break its siege through Tasks to enter. Defeat the boss and claim the victory task to pacify the region.

threat_drowned_reach.name: Drowned Leviathan · Lair
threat_drowned_reach.flavour: Regional threat. Break its siege through Tasks to enter. Defeat the boss and claim the victory task to pacify the region.

threat_heralds_march.name: Warlord of the March · Lair
threat_heralds_march.flavour: Regional threat. Break its siege through Tasks to enter. Defeat the boss and claim the victory task to pacify the region.

dream_choir.name: The Sunken Choir
dream_choir.flavour: Dreamland boss. Dream here for 24 cumulative hours; Essence is spent on every attempt. The core is guaranteed on victory.

dream_tide.name: The Astral Devourer
dream_tide.flavour: Dreamland boss. Dream here for 24 cumulative hours; Essence is spent on every attempt. The core is guaranteed on victory.

dream_sovereign.name: The Sleeping Sovereign
dream_sovereign.flavour: Dream through the Crown for 24 cumulative hours, then pass three waking nightmares to reach the Sleeping Sovereign. Essence is spent on each attempt. The core is guaranteed on victory.

endless_ashes.name: Endless Ashen Descent
endless_ashes.flavour: Automatic descent until retreat or defeat. Every floor increases enemy HP by 12% and damage by 4%. Every tenth floor grants five extra floor rewards. Loot is banked immediately; a new attempt starts at floor 1.

endless_tides.name: Endless Tidal Descent
endless_tides.flavour: Automatic descent until retreat or defeat. Every floor increases enemy HP by 12% and damage by 4%. Every tenth floor grants five extra floor rewards. Loot is banked immediately; a new attempt starts at floor 1.

endless_stars.name: Endless Astral Descent
endless_stars.flavour: Automatic descent until retreat or defeat. Every floor increases enemy HP by 12% and damage by 4%. Every tenth floor grants five extra floor rewards. Loot is banked immediately; a new attempt starts at floor 1.

archive_of_the_unwritten.name: Archive of the Unwritten
archive_of_the_unwritten.flavour: Legendary expedition. Entry provisions are consumed once per attempt, including a retreat or defeat. Repeated clears provide crafting materials.

ironveil_bastion.name: Ironveil Bastion

stages.name: Outer ward
stages.briefing: Melee attacker; weak to magic, resists ranged. Applies burn. Armour absorbs part of every hit. At 50% HP: Furnace ignition.

stages.name: Inner sanctum
stages.briefing: Ranged attacker; weak to melee, resists magic. Applies burn. At 50% HP: Furnace ignition.

stages.name: Throne chamber
stages.briefing: Magic attacker; weak to ranged, resists melee. Applies burn. Reflects a portion of your hits. At 60% HP: Furnace ignition. At 25%: Molten coronation.

ironveil_bastion.flavour: Stronghold siege: three unique boss stages, persistent health and supplies, locked equipment, and no automatic restart. Study affinities and phase mechanics before entry. Retreat or defeat forfeits the full-clear bonus; defeated enemies keep their loot. Provisions are spent once per attempt.

frostglass_citadel.name: Frostglass Citadel

stages.name: Outer ward
stages.briefing: Ranged attacker; weak to melee, resists magic. Applies slow. At 50% HP: Whiteout.

stages.name: Inner sanctum
stages.briefing: Magic attacker; weak to ranged, resists melee. Applies stun. Shrouded evasion. At 50% HP: Whiteout.

stages.name: Throne chamber
stages.briefing: Melee attacker; weak to magic, resists ranged. Applies stun. At 60% HP: Whiteout. At 25%: Absolute winter.

frostglass_citadel.flavour: Stronghold siege: three unique boss stages, persistent health and supplies, locked equipment, and no automatic restart. Study affinities and phase mechanics before entry. Retreat or defeat forfeits the full-clear bonus; defeated enemies keep their loot. Provisions are spent once per attempt.

stages.name: Inner sanctum
stages.briefing: Magic attacker; weak to ranged, resists melee. Applies poison. Reflects a portion of your hits. At 50% HP: Blighted bloom.

stages.name: Throne chamber
stages.briefing: Ranged attacker; weak to melee, resists magic. Applies poison. At 60% HP: Blighted bloom. At 25%: Roots drink deep.

blightroot_hold.flavour: Stronghold siege: three unique boss stages, persistent health and supplies, locked equipment, and no automatic restart. Study affinities and phase mechanics before entry. Retreat or defeat forfeits the full-clear bonus; defeated enemies keep their loot. Provisions are spent once per attempt.

sunken_dominion.name: Sunken Dominion

stages.name: Outer ward
stages.briefing: Melee attacker; weak to magic, resists ranged. Applies bleed. At 50% HP: Crushing depths.

stages.name: Inner sanctum
stages.briefing: Ranged attacker; weak to melee, resists magic. Applies slow. At 50% HP: Crushing depths.

stages.name: Throne chamber
stages.briefing: Magic attacker; weak to ranged, resists melee. Applies silence. Shrouded evasion. At 60% HP: Crushing depths. At 25%: Rising undertow.

sunken_dominion.flavour: Stronghold siege: three unique boss stages, persistent health and supplies, locked equipment, and no automatic restart. Study affinities and phase mechanics before entry. Retreat or defeat forfeits the full-clear bonus; defeated enemies keep their loot. Provisions are spent once per attempt.

eclipse_throne.name: Eclipse Throne

stages.name: Outer ward
stages.briefing: Ranged attacker; weak to melee, resists magic. Applies slow. Shrouded evasion. At 50% HP: Shattered horizon.

stages.name: Inner sanctum
stages.briefing: Magic attacker; weak to ranged, resists melee. Applies silence. At 50% HP: Shattered horizon.

stages.name: Throne chamber
stages.briefing: Melee attacker; weak to magic, resists ranged. Applies stun. Reflects a portion of your hits. At 60% HP: Shattered horizon. At 25%: Total eclipse.

eclipse_throne.flavour: Stronghold siege: three unique boss stages, persistent health and supplies, locked equipment, and no automatic restart. Study affinities and phase mechanics before entry. Retreat or defeat forfeits the full-clear bonus; defeated enemies keep their loot. Provisions are spent once per attempt.

scarecrow_cellar.name: Scarecrow Cellar
scarecrow_cellar.flavour: Clear four encounters beneath the old farm. A forgiving first dungeon with leather and bones for supplies. Final encounter: Strawbound Warden.

ashwood_nest.name: Ashwood Nest
ashwood_nest.flavour: Sweep the outer webs before confronting the brood hunter. Bring food for sustained poison pressure. Final encounter: Cinderweb Broodmother.

barrow_chapel.name: Barrow Chapel
barrow_chapel.flavour: A broken chapel shelters a mixed undead procession. The final wraith tests your defence against magic. Final encounter: Bellkeeper Wraith.

rookwatch_tower.name: Rookwatch Tower
rookwatch_tower.flavour: Fight up the watchtower through melee raiders and ranged sentries to reach the armoured captain. Final encounter: Rookwatch Captain.

shaleheart_vault.name: Shaleheart Vault
shaleheart_vault.flavour: A compact stone siege across three attack styles, ending with the slag golem at the sealed vault. Final encounter: Vaultheart Colossus.

saltglass_catacombs.name: Saltglass Catacombs
saltglass_catacombs.flavour: The flooded crypt alternates spectral magic and brutal melee before the tidewrack hag. Prepare a sustained loadout. Final encounter: Saltglass Oracle.

starfall_bastion.name: Starfall Bastion

stages.name: Outer ward
stages.briefing: A defender of the starfall bastion. Ranged attacker; weak to melee. Phases: Meteor advance, Last stand.

stages.name: Inner sanctum
stages.briefing: A defender of the starfall bastion. Magic attacker; weak to ranged. Phases: Starlit barrage, Last stand.

stages.name: Throne chamber
stages.briefing: A defender of the starfall bastion. Melee attacker; weak to magic. Phases: Falling stars, Final convergence.

starfall_bastion.flavour: Three-stage stronghold siege. Equipment is locked and entry provisions are consumed once per attempt; health and supplies carry between stages. Retreat or defeat forfeits the full-clear bonus.

worldheart_citadel.name: Worldheart Citadel

stages.name: Outer ward
stages.briefing: A guardian of the Worldheart Citadel. Ranged attacker; weak to melee. Phases: Crystal bulwark, Final convergence.

stages.name: Inner sanctum
stages.briefing: A guardian of the Worldheart Citadel. Magic attacker; weak to ranged. Phases: Dawn script, Last stand.

stages.name: Throne chamber
stages.briefing: A guardian of the Worldheart Citadel. Melee attacker; weak to magic. Phases: The heart awakens, Final convergence.

worldheart_citadel.flavour: Three-stage stronghold siege. Equipment is locked and entry provisions are consumed once per attempt; health and supplies carry between stages. Retreat or defeat forfeits the full-clear bonus.

riftbound_spire.name: Riftbound Spire
riftbound_spire.flavour: Legendary expedition: entry provisions are spent once per attempt and equipment is locked until the encounter sequence ends.

final_horizon.name: The Final Horizon
final_horizon.flavour: Legendary expedition: entry provisions are spent once per attempt and equipment is locked until the encounter sequence ends.

stages.name: Inner sanctum

stages.name: Throne chamber
stages.briefing: Magic attacker; weak to ranged, resists melee. Applies burn. At 60% HP: Emberfall. At 25%: Last stand.

ashward_fortress.flavour: Siege the burning ash stronghold in three stages. Equipment stays locked and provisions are spent once per attempt; retreat or defeat forfeits the full-clear reward.

stages.name: Outer ward
stages.briefing: Melee attacker; weak to magic, resists ranged. Applies silence. At 50% HP: Quietus. At 20%: Last stand.

hushspire_hold.flavour: Siege the silence and mist stronghold in three stages. Equipment stays locked and provisions are spent once per attempt; retreat or defeat forfeits the full-clear reward.

stages.briefing: Melee attacker; weak to magic, resists ranged. Applies burn. At 50% HP: Starfire surge. At 20%: Last stand.

stages.name: Inner sanctum
stages.briefing: Ranged attacker; weak to melee, resists magic. Applies burn. At 50% HP: Starfire surge. At 20%: Last stand.

starforge_gatehouse.flavour: Siege the celestial forge stronghold in three stages. Equipment stays locked and provisions are spent once per attempt; retreat or defeat forfeits the full-clear reward.

eventide_rampart.name: Eventide Rampart

stages.name: Outer ward
stages.briefing: Melee attacker; weak to magic, resists ranged. Applies slow. At 50% HP: Eventide ascendant. At 20%: Last stand.

stages.name: Inner sanctum
stages.briefing: Ranged attacker; weak to melee, resists magic. Applies slow. At 50% HP: Eventide ascendant. At 20%: Last stand.

eventide_rampart.flavour: Siege the the crimson eclipse stronghold in three stages. Equipment stays locked and provisions are spent once per attempt; retreat or defeat forfeits the full-clear reward.

emberrift_cavern.name: Emberrift Cavern
emberrift_cavern.flavour: The rift has opened beneath the old bastion; its umbral lord guards a cache of forged supplies.

tidewrought_temple.name: Tidewrought Temple
tidewrought_temple.flavour: A drowned temple draws its guardian through a widening rift.

moonbriar_mausoleum.name: Moonbriar Mausoleum
moonbriar_mausoleum.flavour: The silent dead gather around a mausoleum buried under moonlit thorns.

gilded_clockwork_vault.name: Gilded Clockwork Vault
gilded_clockwork_vault.flavour: A chained sequence of ancient sentinels protects the vault of the last forgemaster.

stormglass_observatory.name: Stormglass Observatory
stormglass_observatory.flavour: A shattered observatory looks into an abyss that has begun to look back.

celestial_rift_gate.name: Celestial Rift Gate
celestial_rift_gate.flavour: The final gate gathers the rift champions for a confrontation at the edge of the horizon.

infernal_crucible.name: The Infernal Crucible
infernal_crucible.flavour: A long endgame raid with 25 ordered encounters. The final boss can drop Crucible Aegis (20%); the first clear awards Crucible Blade. Additional final boss drops: Cinderbound Grips (12%) and Warlord's Pyrecape (8%).

leviathan_cathedral.name: Leviathan Cathedral
leviathan_cathedral.flavour: A long endgame raid with 26 ordered encounters. The final boss can drop Leviathan Crown (20%); the first clear awards Leviathan Spear. Additional final boss drops: Oracle's Tide Charm (12%) and Leviathan Ward (8%).

verdant_oblivion.name: Verdant Oblivion
verdant_oblivion.flavour: A long endgame raid with 27 ordered encounters. The final boss can drop Verdant Sigil (20%); the first clear awards Verdant Staff. Additional final boss drops: Titanbloom Mantle (12%) and Thornheart Charm (8%).

eclipse_citadel.name: Citadel of the Eclipse
eclipse_citadel.flavour: A long endgame raid with 28 ordered encounters. The final boss can drop Eclipse Cloak (20%); the first clear awards Eclipse Longbow. Additional final boss drops: Arbiter's Diadem (12%) and Twilight Bulwark (8%).

throne_beyond_stars.name: Throne Beyond the Stars
throne_beyond_stars.flavour: A long endgame raid with 29 ordered encounters. The final boss can drop Star Throne Ring (20%); the first clear awards Star Throne Blade. Additional final boss drops: Throne Starlight Pendant (12%) and Throne Vestments (8%).

clockwork_caldera.name: Clockwork Caldera
clockwork_caldera.flavour: A long endgame raid with 30 ordered encounters. The final boss can drop Caldera Gauntlets (20%); the first clear awards Caldera Axe. Additional final boss drops: Caldera Furnace Helm (12%) and Clockwork Furnace Plate (8%).

abyssal_crown.name: The Abyssal Crown
abyssal_crown.flavour: A long endgame raid with 31 ordered encounters. The final boss can drop Abyssal Coral Shield (20%); the first clear awards Abyssal Trident. Additional final boss drops: Empress Tide Pendant (12%) and Abyssal Tide Mantle (8%).

gravebound_dominion.name: Gravebound Dominion
gravebound_dominion.flavour: A long endgame raid with 32 ordered encounters. The final boss can drop Gravebound Crown (20%); the first clear awards Gravebound Scythe. Additional final boss drops: Grave King's Mantle (12%) and Grave King's Signet (8%).

dreamglass_labyrinth.name: Dreamglass Labyrinth
dreamglass_labyrinth.flavour: A long endgame raid with 33 ordered encounters. The final boss can drop Dreamglass Amulet (20%); the first clear awards Dreamglass Staff. Additional final boss drops: Weaver's Mirror Ward (12%) and Labyrinth Dream Mantle (8%).

solar_apex.name: The Solar Apex
solar_apex.flavour: A long endgame raid with 34 ordered encounters. The final boss can drop Solar Apex Ring (20%); the first clear awards Solar Apex Blade. Additional final boss drops: Phoenix Sun Crown (12%) and Apex Ascendant Aegis (8%).

shale_watch.name: Shale Watch
shale_watch.flavour: A ruined lookout controls the quarry road; clear its sentries and their captain.

quarry_of_echoes.name: Quarry of Echoes
quarry_of_echoes.flavour: Echoes lure scavengers through a flooded quarry where a brute has made its den.

broken_sentry_keep.name: Broken Sentry Keep
broken_sentry_keep.flavour: A breached keep has become a hunting ground for beasts from the colder hills.

frostbound_sinkhole.name: Frostbound Sinkhole
frostbound_sinkhole.flavour: Frozen tunnels open onto a shrine guarded by an oracle of salt and ice.

brine_tunnels.name: Brine Tunnels
brine_tunnels.flavour: The tide has uncovered a network of smuggler tunnels beneath an old glyphbound post.

saltglass_crypt.name: Saltglass Crypt
saltglass_crypt.flavour: A crypt of saltglass holds the remains of a Sunderhold patrol.

undercroft_annex.name: Undercroft Annex
undercroft_annex.flavour: An abandoned annex links the old undercroft to a seer's guarded chamber.

sunken_armory.name: Sunken Armory
sunken_armory.flavour: Floodwaters have reached the armory, but its siege crew still mans the defenses.

wyrmwatch_gallery.name: Wyrmwatch Gallery
wyrmwatch_gallery.flavour: A gallery of carved wyrms leads to the living dragon that claimed it.

shrine_of_squalls.name: Shrine of Squalls
shrine_of_squalls.flavour: Shattered arches channel the winds into a restless elemental shrine.

drowned_archive.name: Drowned Archive
drowned_archive.flavour: Submerged records lie beneath a veil of mist and tide spirits.

stonebound_labyrinth.name: Stonebound Labyrinth
stonebound_labyrinth.flavour: Living stone closes the paths through a maze once tended by elemental wardens.

ember_choir_catacombs.name: Ember Choir Catacombs
ember_choir_catacombs.flavour: A buried choir hall burns with elemental fire behind its stone guardians.

duskward_foundry.name: Duskward Foundry
duskward_foundry.flavour: A ruined foundry was flooded by the sea; stormglass wardens now guard its heart.

cinder_bastion_depths.name: Cinder Bastion Depths
cinder_bastion_depths.flavour: A deep cinder passage approaches the bastion and its encroaching umbral force.

stormbreak_redoubt.name: Stormbreak Redoubt

stages.name: Squall Gate
stages.briefing: Melee attacker; weak to magic, resists ranged. Enters two stronger phases.

stages.name: Thunder Court
stages.briefing: Magic attacker; weak to ranged, resists melee. Enters two stronger phases.

stages.name: Storm Throne
stages.briefing: Melee attacker; weak to magic, resists ranged. Enters two stronger phases. Signature attack: Tempest Verdict.

stormbreak_redoubt.flavour: A lightning-lashed coastal fortress whose defenders command the storm.

obsidian_crown.name: Obsidian Crown

stages.briefing: Melee attacker; weak to magic, resists ranged. Enters two stronger phases. Signature attack: Crownfire.

obsidian_crown.flavour: A volcanic crown of black stone ruled by a molten colossus.

moonfall_bastion.name: Moonfall Bastion

stages.name: Lunar Causeway
stages.briefing: Melee attacker; weak to magic, resists ranged. Enters two stronger phases.

stages.name: Silver Rampart
stages.briefing: Ranged attacker; weak to melee, resists magic. Enters two stronger phases.

stages.name: Moonlit Throne
stages.briefing: Magic attacker; weak to ranged, resists melee. Enters two stronger phases. Signature attack: Moonlit Silence.

moonfall_bastion.flavour: A silver citadel beneath a moon that never sets.

thornstar_citadel.name: Thornstar Citadel

stages.name: Briar Gate
stages.briefing: Melee attacker; weak to magic, resists ranged. Enters two stronger phases.

stages.name: Bloom Sanctum
stages.briefing: Magic attacker; weak to ranged, resists melee. Enters two stronger phases.

stages.name: Heart of Thorns
stages.briefing: Magic attacker; weak to ranged, resists melee. Enters two stronger phases. Signature attack: Thornstar Venom.

thornstar_citadel.flavour: Star-fed thorns surround a fortress grown from living stone.

dawnspire_fortress.name: Dawnspire Fortress

stages.name: First-Light Gate
stages.briefing: Melee attacker; weak to magic, resists ranged. Enters two stronger phases.

stages.name: Solar Atrium
stages.briefing: Magic attacker; weak to ranged, resists melee. Enters two stronger phases.

stages.name: Dawn Summit
stages.briefing: Melee attacker; weak to magic, resists ranged. Enters two stronger phases. Signature attack: Radiant Judgment.

dawnspire_fortress.flavour: A radiant fortress whose last defenders guard the first light.

furnace_of_fallen_stars.name: Furnace of Fallen Stars
furnace_of_fallen_stars.flavour: A stellar forge consumes fallen stars beneath a molten titan. A long raid with a unique first-clear weapon and three repeatable boss rewards.

maw_of_abyssal_tide.name: Maw of the Abyssal Tide
maw_of_abyssal_tide.flavour: A drowned abyss opens around the throne of a colossal leviathan. A long raid with a unique first-clear weapon and three repeatable boss rewards.

archive_of_the_last_moon.name: Archive of the Last Moon
archive_of_the_last_moon.flavour: A lost archive preserves the prophecies of the last moon. A long raid with a unique first-clear weapon and three repeatable boss rewards.

the_voidborne_nexus.name: The Voidborne Nexus
the_voidborne_nexus.flavour: An unstable rift shelters the behemoth beyond the stars. A long raid with a unique first-clear weapon and three repeatable boss rewards.

sanctum_of_eternal_dawn.name: Sanctum of Eternal Dawn
sanctum_of_eternal_dawn.flavour: A radiant sanctum is defended by the seraph of an endless dawn. A long raid with a unique first-clear weapon and three repeatable boss rewards.

emberglass_bastion.name: Emberglass Bastion

stages.name: Shattered Gate
stages.briefing: Melee attacker; weak to magic and resists ranged. Signature attack: Glassfire Strike.

stages.name: Glass Furnace
stages.briefing: Magic attacker; weak to ranged and resists melee. Signature attack: Emberburst.

stages.name: Tyrant Forge
stages.briefing: Melee attacker; weak to magic and resists ranged. Signature attack: Tyrant Inferno.

emberglass_bastion.flavour: A three-stage siege through Emberglass Bastion. Defeat its champions to claim the stronghold.

tempest_zenith_keep.name: Tempest Zenith Keep

stages.name: Stormwall Gate
